issues.quote: Total assets stood at $619.0 million at the end of fiscal 2025
issues.problem: Wrong unit. Microsoft's total assets were about $619.0 billion, not million. That makes the stated figure about 1,000 times too small.

data.summary: Revenue ($281.7B, up 14.9% from $245.1B), net income ($101.8B), operating income ($128.5B) and cash ($30.2B) match Microsoft's reported FY2025 results. Total assets are given in millions when the correct figure is about $619.0 billion.
